technical.summary: Mixed recovery signals (RSI rising, three white soldiers, supertrend bullish) conflict with bearish structure (price below key MAs, negative MACD, below Ichimoku cloud); insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 34 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for a bullish thesis.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-like 15 score) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite recent congressional selling by bipartisan representatives; no news data to confirm sentiment.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.92), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 34 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + supertrend bullish + extreme fear contrarian signal suggest early reversal setup with support at 49.77 offering defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all key moving averages (21/50/200 EMAs and SMAs), negative MACD/CMF, Ichimoku below cloud, zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis, and earnings in 34 days create overwhelming structural and macro headwinds that invalidate technical recovery signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical recovery signals (three white soldiers, supertrend bullish) and extreme fear contrarian opportunity are offset by structural weakness (price below all key MAs, negative MACD/CMF, Ichimoku below cloud) and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar).
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 34 days combined with VIX crisis and macro recession signals create execution risk that invalidates short-term swing setup; price likely to remain trapped below moving averages until macro clarity.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AOS with 8 existing Industrials positions (27.6% sector concentration); skip entry to avoid concentration risk and preserve capital in unfavourable macro environment.
